Job-market sweep for Prabhavit Gupta, a Venice-based AI/automation engineer. Today is 5 August 2026. Three sweeps have already run and they concentrated on pan-European remote, Germany, Italy, Spain and Portugal. Your slice is the **geographies nobody has touched**: the English-first European markets.

## Candidate profile (never invent beyond this)
- ~3 years experience across eight European companies (UK, Spain, France, Italy, Germany, Luxembourg, Netherlands), mostly freelance or collaborator engagements.
- **Indian passport, Italian EU long-term residence permit** -> no sponsorship needed anywhere in the EU. **NOT UK, NOT Swiss, NOT US authorised** - reject those outright.
- Venice-based. **Confirmed open to an office in any EU city and to relocating anywhere in the EU.** Do not down-score EU relocation.
- Stack: n8n (deep), TypeScript/JavaScript, Next.js, React, Node, PHP/Laravel, Supabase/PostgreSQL, Playwright, Claude Code, OpenAI + Anthropic APIs, Eden AI, Make.com/Zapier/Tray.ai, RAG, LLM agents with human-in-the-loop, Docker, AWS basics. Certifications: Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft AI agents, Power Automate, Tray.ai Build Practitioner.
- Flagship: FlowSpace (Mar 2024 to ongoing) - grew platform 2,000 to 4,500+ users, led Bubble.io to Next.js + Laravel migration on a live product, built AI support agents, CRM lead capture and enrichment, GTM/outbound automations, scraping/parsing pipeline.
- **No GitHub. No CS degree.** No Java, no Go/Rust, no Python backend depth, no Kubernetes, no Vue, no ML research. **English only** - Italian beginner. So a role requiring Dutch, Swedish, Danish, Norwegian, Finnish, Polish, Czech or German is a rejection; say so in your rejected list because the count matters to him.
- Salary target EUR 30,000-40,000. Contract EUR 200/day. **Sole trader on an Italian Partita IVA, NOT a limited company.**

## Your slice
**Ireland first** (English-speaking, EU, huge tech sector, and his permit works there): Dublin, Cork, Galway, plus Ireland-remote.
**Then the Netherlands** (English is the working language at most tech companies): Amsterdam, Utrecht, Rotterdam, Eindhoven, plus NL-remote.
**Then the Nordics**: Stockholm, Copenhagen, Helsinki, Oslo (note Norway is not EU - his permit does not reach it, so reject Norwegian roles), Gothenburg, Malmo.
**Then Belgium and Luxembourg**: Brussels, Antwerp, Ghent, Luxembourg City. He has already worked with a Luxembourg company, which is worth knowing.
**Then CEE**: Warsaw, Krakow, Prague, Brno, Budapest, Bucharest, Sofia, Tallinn, Riga, Vilnius, Ljubljana, Zagreb. These pay less but his EUR 30-40k target is realistic-to-good there, and English-first startups are common.

Titles wide open - anything a mid-level engineer with that profile could do: AI/automation engineer, integration engineer, full-stack, product engineer, solutions engineer, support engineer, technical PM, growth engineer, founding engineer.

**Hosts** (WebSearch `allowed_domains` is a hard filter): `jobs.ashbyhq.com`, `job-boards.greenhouse.io`, `job-boards.eu.greenhouse.io`, `jobs.lever.co`, `jobs.eu.lever.co`, `join.com`, `jobs.workable.com`, `jobs.smartrecruiters.com`, `jobs.personio.com`, `teamtailor.com`, `recruitee.com`, `euremotejobs.com`, `himalayas.app`, `remotive.com`. Note: `teamtailor.com` is huge in the Nordics and customer boards live on per-company subdomains, so filter on the bare domain, not on `jobs.teamtailor.com`.

**Bias toward postings dated within the last 21 days.**

## Verification is the whole job - read this twice
Fetch-based verification has failed repeatedly here:
- **Ashby posting pages are client-rendered and a DELETED Ashby URL still serves its old page title.** Four top-scoring finds in an earlier sweep were reported live by `api.ashbyhq.com` and returned "Job not found" the second a real browser opened them.
- **Greenhouse board APIs report closed jobs as live**; the posting URL then serves the multi-job board index. Confirmed twice.
